changes: Replace synchronous profile-to-attributes import with a deterministic original ai_jobs anchor, compact exact-owner start/get/list/resume APIs and an explicitly registered independent worker. Legacy synchronous callers fail with a refresh instruction rather than treating a queued job as a saved file.

Persist reserved, model_dispatched, analysis_ready and file_committed checkpoints. Mark dispatch before the only pinned published Rufus Skill invocation. Reclaimed/unknown dispatches cannot repeat the model. Resume safe failures on the same runId; saved analysis resumes persistence only.

A strict real transaction atomically writes the attribute file, initial analysis version, three complete inline artifacts, safe success audit and authoritative file receipt. Readbacks and SQL worker/attempt/lease fences reject partial, stale or lossy results. No new schema or cloud storage call.

Reload actor/default workspace/role and target import permissions, exact source assignment and complete source hash under transaction locks. Keep established NULL-parent rules. Lock and verify actual Listing Agent/N3 identities; cancellation blocks subsequent execution/commit. Source-only derivation and job-first lock ordering avoid the identified policy/job deadlock.

New-kind-only runtime claim/progress/fail/heartbeat/release CAS and dedicated completion rule; generic create/cancel/recover/read/confirm routes cannot bypass the protocol or expose private input checkpoints. Other kinds retain their prior paths.

Explicit preview and submit, compact task polling, refresh recovery, exact-tuple lost-ACK lookup, no automatic mutation retry, same-source unknown barrier and fresh-preview same-run resume. Preserve authenticated owner epochs and drafts, including auth-suspension settlement; each completion dispatches the five read invalidations once.

Normalize one complete human-entered source for model/file/hash, keep source-row hash separate, and add exact-scoped inline artifact reading for long raw sources before fact review. AI suggestions are not fact inputs. Latest valid completed file wins over older analyses; seven directions and fact/core/candidate review remain unchanged.

Hide only inaccessible/missing historical sources from job lists after locking/authorizing the current actor/target. Do not swallow DB/schema/current authorization errors or allow direct reads of revoked sources. Parent-canceled tasks show non-resumable status.
